title: pi-foreman configuration
description: One config layer or the merged result. Layers: L1 defaults, L3 organisation package, L2 <agent dir>/foreman.json, project .pi/foreman.json (trusted only, may only tighten safety.*), session. Merge is plain last-wins per key.

displayNames.description: A preset name from displayPresets ("classic" or "plain" ship in L1) or a per-id map {role id: display name}. Display names are cosmetic; no code compares them.

displayPresets.description: Named display-name presets, each a map {role id: display name}.

roles.description: Per-role settings keyed by neutral role id (explorer, builder, reviewer, senior-reviewer, finalizer, foreman, or an overlay role).

file.description: Path of a role file that replaces the prompt (L2/L3 only).

promptAppend.description: Text appended to the role prompt.

tools.description: Strict tool allowlist. Written as a JSON array into the generated settings. For the foreman it is informational. A project or session can only narrow it (intersection), and cannot add role ids.

codemode.description:
Add the codemode tool to this role. Overridden per provider by providers.

.roles..codemode.

launch.description: How the role is launched. Only detached is supported: detached children forward permission asks to the parent. A project or session cannot set it.

providers.description: Provider map keyed by Pi provider id (for example github-copilot, openrouter). L1 ships none; overlays supply it.

costTier.description: Relative cost tier. A fallback to a higher tier needs one confirmation per session.

roles.description: Role to model map for this provider.

model.description: Full model id as Pi expects it, for example <provider>/<model>.

codemode.description: Per role and provider override of roles.<id>.codemode.

review.description: Model review of permission asks (link foreman-review) while this provider is active. Without it every ask goes to the human. Ignored in the project and session layers (it loosens).

model.description: Reviewer model, <provider>/<model> or a bare model id of this provider.

timeoutMs.description: Review timeout in ms (default 15000); a timeout defers to the human.

fallback.description: One explicit fallback provider that resolves roles this provider does not map. Used only on auth failure or unavailability.

provider.description: Provider id whose map is used for roles missing here.

confirm.description: Ask once per session before using the fallback.

maxThinking.description: Ceiling for every role's thinking level.

default.description: Tier assumed when no signal applies.

heavySignals.description: Keywords or areas that make a task heavy.

heavyFileCount.description: A task touching more files than this is heavy.

safety.description: Safety policy. An invalid value in a layer is dropped from that layer with a warning; the other layers still apply. The project layer can only tighten it.

deny.description: Bash patterns that are always denied, on top of the baseline. A project can add entries, not remove them.

ask.description: Bash patterns that need approval. A project can add entries, not remove them.

allow.description: Bash patterns (permission-system wildcard syntax) allowed without asking, on top of the baseline. A project or session cannot extend it.

projectCommands.description: The repo's own test and build commands, as bash patterns; allowed without asking. A project or session cannot set it.

deny.description: Path patterns that tools and shell commands may never touch, on top of the baseline secret paths. A project can add entries, not remove them.

ask.description: Path patterns that need approval. A project can add entries, not remove them.

requiredChildExtensions.description: Extension paths every child must load. A project can add entries, not remove them.

mayPush.description: Whether children may push. A project can only set false.

required.description: Require a review before close-out. A project can only set true.

protectedBranches.description: Branches (fnmatch patterns) that never receive a force push, mirror push or delete from the foreman. A project can add entries, not remove them.

messagePattern.description: Python regular expression the commit subject must match (re.search). null switches the check off. A project cannot set it.

requiredTrailers.description: Regular expressions; each must match one trailer line (Key: value) of the message. A project can add entries, not remove them.

forbiddenTrailers.description: Regular expressions no trailer line may match. A project can add entries, not remove them.

checkCommand.description: argv of a command run before each foreman commit, with the staged diff on stdin and the message in PI_FOREMAN_COMMIT_MESSAGE; a non-zero exit blocks the commit. It executes a program, so only the organisation and user layers may set it; a project value is ignored.

copyMaxBytes.description: Size cap for foreman_copy. A project can only lower it.

worktreeDisposable.description: Path components whose ignored files foreman_worktree_remove may delete ('name/' = a directory). A project cannot set it.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for the merged check of foreman_worktree_remove; null = origin HEAD, else main, else master. A project cannot set it.

allowWorkflow.description: Let subagent workflow scripts and schedule.* actions through; they can launch any agent with any model, unchecked by the role allowlist and the role map. Loosening key: L1, overlays and the user file only; project and session values are ignored.

preconditionOps.description: Settings for the precondition-checked operations. A project cannot set it.

isolateClaudeConfig.description: Point CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at an empty pi-foreman folder so the claude bridge ignores the host's Claude Code settings, hooks, plugins and CLAUDE.md. auto = on when the active provider is claude-bridge. A project cannot set it.

path.description: Python interpreter (3.9 or newer). null means auto-detect. It runs every guard, so a project or session value is ignored.

dir.description: Trace directory. null means the state dir. A project or session value must resolve inside the workspace, else it is ignored.
